# Planet-Man Comics

> Planet-Man Comics is a static comic-reader site for an original superhero fantasy series about Planet-Man, a restless creator god with miniature-planet powers, and Shrink-Scope, the clairvoyant hero who recruits him to protect one of his forgotten worlds.

The canonical public reader is hosted at https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Planet-Man-Comics/web-app/. The repository also includes PDF issues, source scripts, reference images, a series guide, and generated static pages for sharing, search indexing, and bonus material.

## Core Pages

- [Reader home](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Planet-Man-Comics/web-app/): Browser reader for the complete Planet-Man issue catalog.
- [Issue archive](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Planet-Man-Comics/web-app/issues/): Static index of individual issue share pages.
- [Bonus page](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Planet-Man-Comics/web-app/bonus/): Series guide material and reference-image gallery.
- [Follow page](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Planet-Man-Comics/web-app/follow/): Email subscription page for release updates.
- [Other comics](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Planet-Man-Comics/web-app/other-comics/): Links to related comic projects.

## Machine-Readable Resources

- [Sitemap](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Planet-Man-Comics/sitemap.xml): Search index of the public web app and issue pages.
- [RSS feed](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Planet-Man-Comics/rss.xml): Newest-first feed of published issues.
- [Robots file](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Planet-Man-Comics/robots.txt): Crawler policy for the site.
- [Issue catalog JSON](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Planet-Man-Comics/web-app/comics.json): Static fallback catalog used by the reader.
- [Bonus data JSON](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Planet-Man-Comics/web-app/bonus-data.json): Static fallback data for bonus material and reference prompts.

## Source Documents

- [Planet-Man Series Guide](https://github.com/JetBlackRLSH/Planet-Man-Comics/blob/main/Planet-Man%20Series%20Guide.md): Continuity guide, issue index, summaries, relevant characters, series elements, and ongoing threads.
- [Planet-Man Series Idea](https://github.com/JetBlackRLSH/Planet-Man-Comics/blob/main/Planet-Man%20Series%20Idea.md): Series concept material.
- [Art Style Guide](https://github.com/JetBlackRLSH/Planet-Man-Comics/blob/main/Art%20Style%20Guide.md): Visual style direction.
- [Reference image prompts](https://github.com/JetBlackRLSH/Planet-Man-Comics/blob/main/Reference%20Images/reference-image-prompts.md): Prompt metadata for tracked reference images.

## Notes For Automated Readers

The web app's checked-in `web-app/comics.json` file is the stable static catalog. On GitHub Pages, the reader and bonus page can also fetch live repository data from GitHub to discover newly tracked issue folders and `Reference Images/` assets after they are pushed.
